root_idea.summary: The root centers on burden, excess, and departure from a balanced or just state: what burdens or overwhelms, the dependants one sustains, and an apportionment or judgment that exceeds its proper limit.
root_idea.development: The lexical evidence connects bearing burdens and sustaining dependants with excess, imbalance, and injustice; related branches also express reliance, seeking aid, and lamentation.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form عَالَ rather than the Quranic imperfect تَعُولُ.

senses.definition: To deviate from justice or the right course; to act wrongfully or oppressively.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction أَلَّا تَعُولُوا, the verb is interpreted as a warning against deviation from the right course and injustice.

senses.definition: To have a numerous household or an excessive number of dependants.
senses.usage_conditions: This is an alternative lexical interpretation of أَلَّا تَعُولُوا in Quran 4:3, referring to the burden of a numerous household rather than directly to judicial deviation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feed, nourish, sustain, and provide for one's family or household.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a household, family, or an individual whose means of subsistence one supplies.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become poor or in want.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A less common intransitive use, also expressed by related forms in the same lexical branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a balance, to incline, become defective, exceed, or depart from its proper state; figuratively, to act unfaithfully.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The balance may rise on one side or fail to represent an even or faithful measure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an inheritance apportionment, to exceed the total of the fixed primary shares, thereby reducing the shares received by the heirs; transitively, to cause this excess.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical legal use concerning the arithmetic excess of the prescribed inheritance portions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an affair or event, to be hard to bear, severe, distressing, or formidable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use describes the severity or burden of an affair rather than an action performed upon a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overcome, burden, oppress, distress, or disquiet a person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is also used in passive expressions for patience or another faculty being overcome, and in proverbial or figurative applications.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise, or be raised, after stumbling or falling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression in which the agent effecting the raising may be understood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have one's lamentation or wailing raised; an imprecation that one's mother be bereaved of one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression of lamentation or bereavement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make people dependants, neglect one's family, or feed them inadequately.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form II branch concerns poor or neglected provision rather than ordinary support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To impose an affair or burden upon someone; to behave presumptuously toward someone in reliance on his affection or tolerance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Commonly construed with عَلَى and an object upon whom an affair is placed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask aid or assistance from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A related construction uses بِهِ or an equivalent prepositional complement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rely upon, place confidence in, or seek support from a thing or person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction عَلَيْهِ marks the object of reliance; some attestations are interpreted differently as forms of lamentation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of weeping or lamentation; in an alternative interpretation, the act of weeping.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This meaning is reported as an interpretation of a poetic occurrence and is distinct from the ordinary sense of reliance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The seeking of a means by which one may obtain benefit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported alternative interpretation of the poetic expression involving مُعَوَّل.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To construct a shelter from rain called عَالَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The shelter is made by binding branches together and covering them with small cut wood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To weep, wail, and raise one's voice in crying out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form may be used with عَلَى for the person or thing mourned.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bow, to produce a sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or transferred use derived from the sound of raised lamentation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desire, covet, or pursue something vehemently, greedily, or excessively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use may carry a reproachful sense of excessive avidity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression مَا لَهُ عَالٌ وَلَا مَالٌ, to have nothing belonging to oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed phrase combining the word with مَالٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Woe, lamentation, or an imprecation directed against someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in accusative expressions of blame, prayer, or distress, sometimes following وَيْلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An affair or event that causes anxiety or distress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a substantivized use describing a distressing matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose aid is sought in a difficult or important affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the relied-upon helper rather than the act of asking for help.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The food or provision of a family or household.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use related to the act of sustaining dependants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Reliance, confidence, or a source of support.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression هُوَ عِوَلِي, the person is described as one's stay or support; the form is subject to variant analysis in an attested poem.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weeping or repeated lamentation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported alternative grammatical analysis treats the form as connected with عَوْلٌ and interprets it as weeping or weepings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An asking for aid or assistance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use distinct from the person or thing relied upon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A shelter or covering made for protection from rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The shelter is constructed from cut branches and similar material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An ostrich; alternatively, a shelter or covering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical evidence records both the animal sense and the shelter sense under this form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wailing: raising the voice while weeping, or weeping with a cry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may also mean a cry or chest voice without weeping, or the inward burning of grief or love without outward crying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use, distinct from the noun meaning wailing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One of the ropes of a ship or boat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nautical use derived from the sense of weakness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A family, household, or the persons whom someone feeds and whose expenses are incumbent upon him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may include a spouse, child, young person, slave, or other dependant; by extension it can describe dependants among birds and beasts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cooking pot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metaphorical expression based on the pot's provision for the household.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Want or need.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intrusion at feasts as an uninvited guest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized social use referring to someone who joins a feast without invitation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weeping or lamentation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-verbal noun of عَوَّلَ, with a plural عَوَاوِيلُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an affair or event, hard to bear, severe, distressing, or formidable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participle form used adjectivally with an affair or event.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a measure of capacity, exceeding others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use applied to a capacity measure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most hard to bear; more severe or formidable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or elative form; an occurrence of أَعْلَى is reported as a transposed equivalent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fed, nourished, or sustained.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of one who has been provided for.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Overcome or overborne, especially with respect to a person's patience, opinion, or judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning describes a faculty or judgment that has been overwhelmed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One for whom lamentation is made; one who is bewailed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually followed by عَلَيْهِ and used especially of a dead person for whom wailing is performed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pickaxe or heavy iron tool used to peck or hollow out rock or stone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete implement used on rocks, large masses of stone, or mountains.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man with a family or household whom he must support; also, one whose property is insufficient and whose household has overwhelmed him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The second use emphasizes that the financial burden of the household exceeds the man's means.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One whose aid or succour is sought, or upon whom reliance and confidence are placed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes a person who serves as a source of aid or support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A constructor of a rain shelter of the kind called عَالَةٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized active-participle use referring to the person who builds that shelter.

cautions: The sole Quran occurrence is the imperfect form تَعُولُوا, publicly normalized here under the classical perfect citation form عَالَ.

Quran 4:3 has two explicitly attested lexical interpretations in the supplied evidence: deviation from justice and having a numerous household. The Quran Foundation gloss illustrates the first but does not by itself establish either sense.
